detailed_description: LTX2-ICLoRA is an audio-video generation diffusion model. This config exposes a video generation interface (text-to-video with optional image conditioning).

parameters.name: video_url
parameters.description: Input video URL. Supported: mp4, mov, webm, m4v, gif.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: Optional conditioning image URL (for image-to-video / first-frame conditioning). Supported formats: .jpg/.jpeg/.png. Max 10MB.

parameters.name: match_video_length
parameters.description: If enabled, num_frames will be derived from input video duration and FPS.

parameters.name: num_frames
parameters.description: Number of video frames to generate. LTX-2 commonly expects frames = (8 x K) + 1 (e.g., 121).

parameters.name: match_input_fps
parameters.description: If enabled, output FPS matches the input video's FPS.

parameters.name: frame_rate
parameters.description: Output video frame rate (frames per second).

parameters.name: video_strength
parameters.description: Video conditioning strength. Lower = more freedom to change the video content.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Output video height in pixels. LTX-2 typically requires height divisible by 32.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Output video width in pixels. LTX-2 typically requires width divisible by 32.
